title: AQFT Locality of Unitary Vertex Operator Algebras
exact_target: For every unitary vertex operator algebra, do the smeared vertex operators satisfy the strong locality needed to produce a conformal net of local von Neumann algebras? Strong locality requires the algebras associated with disjoint intervals to commute.
